CREATE TABLE "public"."Nugget" (
  "audioUrl" text,
  "bibleSection" text NOT NULL,
  "book" text NOT NULL,
  "challenges" text[] NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "duration" text NOT NULL,
  "featured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text NOT NULL,
  "isGold" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "keyPrinciple" text NOT NULL,
  "marketplaceApplication" text NOT NULL,
  "number" int4 NOT NULL,
  "practicalActionPlan" text[] NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "scriptureRef" text NOT NULL,
  "scriptureText" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "tag" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "topic" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Nugget_challenges_elem_not_null_8c29d25c" CHECK (array_position("challenges", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "Nugget_practicalActionPlan_elem_not_null_d53b649f" CHECK (array_position("practicalActionPlan", NULL) IS NULL)
)
